knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The guideline weighs how likely exposure is, what kind of body substance is present and how the organism probably spreads. The other options are not among the factors it names.
The gloves come off first because their outside is contaminated, followed by hand cleaning. The other items come later in the sequence.
The guideline's sequence says to remove protective equipment at the doorway or in an anteroom. The other places are not in the guideline.

practicalCriteria: Learner puts on protective equipment in the correct order, cleaning hands at the start.
Learner removes protective gear in sequence, cleaning hands after the gloves and again after the last item, and never touches the front of any item.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation record of the donning and doffing sequence
stopWorkCriteria: Protective equipment is missing or the wrong size for the task
The learner touches the outside of a glove, gown or mask during removal and does not stop to clean hands
The task involves a P2 respirator and no fit or training record is on file
